t: Four things that all fail in the same way
a: أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الأَرْبَعِ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لاَ يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لاَ يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لاَ تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ دُعَاءٍ لاَ يُسْمَعُ
p: Aʿūdhu bika mina-l-arbaʿ: min ʿilmin lā yanfaʿ, wa min qalbin lā yakhshaʿ, wa min nafsin lā tashbaʿ, wa min duʿāʾin lā yusmaʿ
m: I seek refuge in You from four: from knowledge that does not benefit, from a heart that does not humble itself, from a self that is never satisfied, and from a supplication that is not heard.
